users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage accounts, role access and Dead Man's Switch holds.

empty.title: No users found
empty.text: Check the spelling, or clear the role and status filters.

success.grant: {{role}} granted to {{email}}. They need to sign in again.
success.rescue: {{executor}} is now the executor of {{email}} and will receive an activation email within a few minutes.

lock.title: Lock this account?
lock.message: {{email}} will not be able to sign in.

unlock.title: Unlock this account?
unlock.message: {{email}} will be able to sign in again.

grant.title: Grant {{role}}?
grant.message: {{email}} will get {{role}} access after signing in again.

suspend.title: Suspend Dead Man's Switch?
suspend.message: The switch of {{email}} will stop counting until resumed. The owner cannot resume it.

resume.title: Resume Dead Man's Switch?
resume.message: The switch of {{email}} will start counting again.

rescue.title: Assign an emergency executor?
rescue.message: The Dead Man's Switch of {{email}} has been triggered, but no executor can act. The person you enter becomes the primary executor immediately and must have a verified LegacyVault account.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: Create custom roles and choose which permissions each role grants.

deleteDialog.title: Delete role {{code}}?
deleteDialog.message: This cannot be undone. Remove the role from all users first.

form.name: Name
form.codeError: 3–50 characters: A–Z, 0–9 or _, starting with a letter.

alerts.subtitle: Suspicious activity detected from the audit log every 5 minutes. HIGH alerts are also emailed to admins.
